title: Search
lead: Search all three sections, referral requests and the Community at once. The home page is a hub, not a section.
short: Please enter at least two characters.
postRequest: Post what you need as a request
noQuery: Enter a search term. Tap the search box to see suggested keywords and results by section right away.

prompt.needText: Describe what you are looking for in a sentence. e.g. Any retail spaces under 10 pyeong (about 33㎡) for quick sale?
prompt.failed: Search failed. Please try again shortly.
prompt.offline: Connection lost. Please try again shortly.
prompt.placeholder: e.g. Any retail spaces under 10 pyeong (about 33㎡) for quick sale?
prompt.readHead: Here is how we read it
prompt.readNone: Could not read any conditions (size · price · area · status).
prompt.pickYourself: If this is not right, pick one below.
prompt.blocked: SogaeBank does not handle this business type.
prompt.unclear: Not clear enough. Please choose a section yourself.
prompt.hint: Ads are excluded from ranking. Candidates are scored only by matched words.
prompt.privacy: Search terms are processed temporarily for classification and are not stored.
prompt.privacyWhy: You get the same results whether or not you are logged in, because no account information is sent.
